creator: Alexander Terp
description: Alex's chat note, 2026-07-05: "watch mode, for long queries for example". Like watch(1): rerun a script, or a query inside one, on an interval and redraw its output in place. RAD-300 (3d87pqXK) is a different trigger, a function that fires when a file changes.
title: Watch mode: rerun a script on an interval and redraw its output
